ownership_rule: The project owns this database; no application owns it or its table. The history of a clip's edits reaches it only through the one intermediary of the project database (qnc.module.db-broker), whose table module qnc.module.edit-history owns it.

rules.per_clip: The history is kept per clip, the newest 200 entries; the first entry of a clip is its state before its first edit.
rules.back: Going back to an entry is a write of the owner of its state and itself a new entry; nothing is deleted by it.
